title: Overview
body: docc is a compiler and linter for documentation written as JSON. It checks structure, links, content and style, and builds Markdown for people to read. ^OVE-1
Start with [[document-model@d9p7]] to see what a document looks like, then [[agent-workflow@ub9c]] for the loop an agent follows. ^OVE-3
